ruled_out_vectors.vector: uint128 truncation in DynamicHelper._getTokensOwed when feeGrowthInside delta * liquidity / Q128 exceeds uint128.max
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Requires feeGrowthInside delta * liquidity > uint256.max which is handled by FullMath.mulDiv. The uint128 cast only truncates if result > uint128.max, requiring astronomical fee accumulation relative to liquidity. Not economically achievable.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: computeRatioX96 overflow returns 0 — zero-price bypass in downstream consumers
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Previously submitted and rejected (FP-SUB02). View function only, unrealistic overflow inputs, CLOB handler constrains amounts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Round-trip swap profit via rounding direction mismatch between input and output calculations
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: INV-SW02 holds: round-trip always loses value to fees and rounding. Tested with standard pool + 1000 token swap.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dust loop draining pool reserves via repeated 1-wei swaps
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: INV-SW03 holds: pool reserves never decrease from dust swaps. 100 consecutive 1-wei swaps, pool balance non-decreasing.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: TickMath division-before-multiplication precision loss at extreme ticks
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Standard Uniswap V3 pattern. Round-trip exact at all ticks. Tested every 1000th tick from -887000 to +887000.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: SwapMath free tokens from 1-wei input with fee or 100% fee bypass
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: 1-wei input with 30% fee produces 0 output. 100% fee sends all to feeAmount. Fuzz confirms amountIn + feeAmount <= input.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: SqrtPriceMath rounding direction mismatch between roundUp and roundDown variants
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: roundUp >= roundDown invariant holds. Equal prices return 0. Input rounds up, output rounds down.
Lines 1799 and 1899 use quotient/remainder pattern — correctly computes full heights moved plus leftover.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: FixedHelper fee collection truncation in _collectPositionSide via Q128 division
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: fee = (feeGrowthInside - feeGrowthInsideLast) / Q128 truncates down. LP gets slightly less. Favors protocol (INV-SW03).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: FeeHelper asymmetric fee validation allowing >100% BPS on input swaps
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Intentional design. Input allows >MAX_BPS but is config error (self-inflicted). Output requires <MAX_BPS. Both favor protocol.
